premises.text: Climate change is a significant problem that requires urgent action.
premises.evidence_span: climate change is a big problem

premises.text: Human emissions are significantly greater than the weight of humanity.
premises.evidence_span: the weight of our emissions every year is a hundred times more than the weight of humanity as a whole

premises.text: There is an energy-efficient and scalable way to capture CO2 emissions.
premises.evidence_span: an energy efficient scalable way to capture these emissions

premises.text: Captured CO2 can be converted into nanomaterials.
premises.evidence_span: we fix it into a solid powder so we basically combine or trap that gas into a solid powder and what we make at the end of it is nanomaterials

premises.text: Different materials can be used to capture CO2 depending on geographical availability.
premises.evidence_span: we don't just have to use one type of material to capture CO2. Depending on where you are in the world you have access to different powders or formations in the geology

premises.text: The materials derived from CO2 capture can be used in various applications, including construction and drug delivery.
premises.evidence_span: these materials which are derived from pollution can actually potentially be used for chemotherapy drugs as well

premises.text: The business model allows for the creation of marketable products while reducing carbon emissions.
premises.evidence_span: this is a business model that allows us to create real products to sell into the market and then also create carbon reductions every time that we do make a sale

premises.text: The carbon coating product is being adopted by large brands and is gaining acceptance in the market.
premises.evidence_span: this is a coating very similar to something you might buy at the store when you do a home renovation project but this is specifically designed for water and wastewater infrastructure

premises.text: The technology can significantly reduce carbon emissions and improve the strength of buildings.
premises.evidence_span: one use of this technology can not only capture enough carbon to take as many as 29 or 30 million cars off the road but actually make our buildings 20 to 30% stronger

value.text: Carbon emissions can be captured and converted into useful products, contributing to a better society.
value.evidence_span: capture them in a way that actually creates a better society which is more advanced than the one we live in today

notes: The focus on engaging with institutions for tangible products from carbon emissions is excluded as it does not constitute a premise.
